_help: Which model each agent role runs on: "<provider>/<model>" from pi-ai's catalog, preferred first. A step whose model fails (after the provider's own retries) moves to the next entry. Entries without a login (the provider's API key, e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) are skipped. review and judge never use the coder's model family. aliases: roles that share another role's chain. coordinate: the coordinator, called when a check fails or a push is refused, on Sonnet 5.5 first.
